title: console: opening a notification from the Home "Notifications" card does not mark it read (the bell popover does)
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a product defect found by a QA run (off-clause probe, RUNNER rule 8).

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase. Mint a member (invite, then sign up) and reassign a showcase_task to that member's email, so they get one unread `task.assigned` notification.
2. As the member, open the console Home. In the "My work → Notifications" card, click the notification.
3. Expected: the same as clicking it in the bell popover. `POST /api/v1/notifications/read {"ids":[ID]}` fires and `unreadCount` goes 1 → 0.
4. Actual: the click navigates to the record, but no read POST fires. `GET /api/v1/notifications` still reports `unreadCount: 1`, also after a reload. The bell badge stays.

## Mechanism
`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx` ~L841–852: `onOpenNotification` only navigates (or opens a window). The bell popover's `InboxPopover.handleNotificationClick` calls `onMarkRead` before navigating. The same notification has two doors with different read semantics.
